comment:
* Provides APIs for the supplementary service settings using IMS (Ut interface).
 * It is created from 3GPP TS 24.623 (XCAP(XML Configuration Access Protocol)
 * over the Ut interface for manipulating supplementary services).
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: KEY_CATEGORY
variables.comment:
* Categories :
     *      "OIP", "OIR", "TIP", "TIR", "CDIV", "CB", "CW", "CONF",
     *      "ACR", "MCID", "ECT", "CCBS", "AOC", "MWI", "FA", "CAT"
     *
     * Detailed parameter name will be determined according to the properties
     * of the supplementary service configuration.

variables.name: SERVICE_CLASS_NONE
variables.comment: These service class values are same as the one in CommandsInterface.java

methods.name: public void close()
public void registerForSuppServiceIndication(Handler h, int what, Object obj)
methods.comment:
* Registers a handler for Supplementary Service Indications. The
     * result is returned in the {@link AsyncResult#result) field
     * of the {@link AsyncResult} object returned by {@link Message.obj}.
     * Value of ((AsyncResult)result.obj) is of {@link ImsSsData}.

methods.name: public void unregisterForSuppServiceIndication(Handler h)
methods.comment: * UnRegisters a handler for Supplementary Service Indications.

methods.name: public void queryCallBarring(int cbType, Message result)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves the configuration of the call barring.
     *
     * @param cbType type of call barring to be queried; ImsUtInterface#CB_XXX
     * @param result message to pass the result of this operation
     *      The return value of ((AsyncResult)result.obj) is an array of {@link ImsSsInfo}.
     * @deprecated Use {@link #queryCallBarring(int, Message, int)} instead.

methods.name: public void queryCallBarring(int cbType, Message result, int serviceClass)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves the configuration of the call barring for specified service class.
     *
     * @param cbType type of call barring to be queried; ImsUtInterface#CB_XXX
     * @param result message to pass the result of this operation
     *      The return value of ((AsyncResult)result.obj) is an array of {@link ImsSsInfo}.
     * @param serviceClass service class for e.g. voice/video

methods.name: public void queryCallForward(int condition, String number, Message result)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves the configuration of the call forward.
     * The return value of ((AsyncResult)result.obj) is an array of {@link ImsCallForwardInfo}.

methods.name: public void queryCallWaiting(Message result)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves the configuration of the call waiting.
     * The return value of ((AsyncResult)result.obj) is an array of {@link ImsSsInfo}.

methods.name: public void queryCLIR(Message result)
methods.comment: * Retrieves the default CLIR setting.

methods.name: public void queryCLIP(Message result)
methods.comment: * Retrieves the CLIP call setting.

methods.comment: * Retrieves the COLP call setting.
